definition: Consolidated net profit after finance costs, depreciation, the reported exceptional employee-benefit provision and tax. This is not EBITDA or PAT before exceptional items.

rows.name: Milk and milk-related products · whole group

location: PDF page 14, consolidated audited annual results, FY ended 31 March 2026 column, rows 1 and 9; PDF page 15, Notes 1, 3 and 7
notes: Source and display use ₹ crore. Revenue excludes ₹53.46 crore other income. The exceptional provision is ₹5.72 crore. The group reports one milk-related operating segment; brand-level profit is not provided. Standalone-company PAT differs from this consolidated group figure.
insight: The group earned a net profit overall. These totals cannot show how much Gowardhan, Go, Pride of Cows or Avvatar individually earned.
